name: CN_SRP_ASSESS_ALL_INT
description: The CN_SRP_ASSESS_ALL table stores information about participant plan objectives and objectives performance assessments.

columns.name: SRP_ASSESS_ID
columns.description: Primart key, The unique identifier for the objectives performance assessment record

columns.name: SRP_COMP_PLAN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the participant plan record.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the participant record.

columns.name: COMP_PLAN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the plan record.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_ID
columns.description: The objectives performance assessment number.

columns.name: COMP_PLAN_ASSESS_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the plan objectives record.

columns.name: ASSESS_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the objectives template record.

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the current user responsible for performing an objectives assessment.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the objectives assessment period starts.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the objectives assessment period ends.

columns.name: ASSESS_STATUS
columns.description: The lookup code that represents the current objectives assessment status, such as not started or pending review.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The lookup code that represents whether a transaction, representing the objective assessment performance score, was submitted for transaction collection.

columns.name: CURRENT_OWNER_TYPE
columns.description: The code that represents the current owner type, such as participant, manager, or designated owner.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_SCORE
columns.description: The value, provided by the participant manager, used as the participant credit amount in place of the calculated assessment score.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_JUSTIFICATION
columns.description: Text, provided by the participant manager, which describes the justification for overriding the participant calculated assessment score.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Worker Number that will process this row. This worker number will belong between a range depending on the organization of the compensation plan.
